## Featured project
HR Recruitment Automation with n8n is a self-initiated portfolio project. It demonstrates candidate intake, experience-based routing, Google Sheets integration, Telegram HR notifications, shortlist/reject handling, Gmail communication, and candidate status tracking. The displayed project value is an estimated solution value, not client payment.
